level.what: Place the state on the ordered levels offered, lowest first. Level 0 is the floor and the last level is the ceiling; a genuinely benign state belongs at level 0.
level.not_for: Recomputing anything the solver produced. The levels describe situations; match the state to the one it is in.

driver.what: An independent claim about the state that may or may not drive the level. Answer it on its own merits against `state.input`.
driver.not_for: Justifying the level chosen. A claim that is true but immaterial is still true; the caller decides which drivers to report.
